title: Demo content — a seeded beit midrash so the feed is alive on the first visit

tasks.title: The demo scenario, the seed's social rows, and seeding for a real account

acs.text: WHEN `npm run qa:seed -- demo` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create, by stable ids, at least 3 institution profiles, 4 person profiles (invented people; no personal data), 12 posts across Tanakh, Talmud and liturgy with sources, replies, reactions, follows between them and administrators for the institutions, so that a persona who follows the institutions sees a full Following tab; running it a second time creates nothing new.
scenarios: AC-001 the demo scenario seeds a living community, once

acs.text: WHEN `npm run qa:seed -- demo --for <userId>` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL also make that user follow the demo institutions and administer one of them, so a real reader account opening the feed sees a full timeline and can post as the institution.
scenarios: AC-002 the demo scenario for a real account
